texts.title: Operating instructions
texts.intro: These instructions show you, room by room, what the push-buttons in your home do and how to use them. Each push-button is shown as it looks on the wall.
texts.toc_general: Using your push-buttons, central functions, troubleshooting, contact
texts.haus: Your home is equipped with KNX. Push-buttons, presence detectors and sensors send their commands over a dedicated control line to switching devices in the distribution board, which control lighting, blinds and heating. This is why a push-button can also switch lights in another room, and functions can be changed later without new wiring.
texts.tip_short: Short press: tap briefly, e.g. to switch the light on or off.
texts.tip_long: Long press: hold the button down (about one second or longer).
texts.tip_dim: Dimming: hold the button until the desired brightness is reached, then release.
texts.tip_blinds: Blinds: a long press moves them fully up or down; a short press stops them or tilts the slats.
texts.tip_double: Double-click: press twice briefly in a row.
texts.tip_led: The indicator lights on the buttons show whether the function is switched on.
texts.tip_night: At night the indicator lights are dimmed automatically.
texts.central_intro: These buttons act on several rooms or the whole house:
texts.time_intro: These functions run automatically according to the time of day or the position of the sun. You can override them manually at any time.
texts.stoerungen:
• A light does not respond: first check whether the bulb is defective and whether a fuse has tripped in the distribution board.
• Several push-buttons no longer respond: please do not change anything yourself and contact us – the control system is probably affected.
• Blinds do not move: in wind or frost they are often locked for protection and only move again once the danger has passed.
texts.thermostat_text: Button {keys}: raise or lower the desired room temperature.
texts.heating_auto: Heating: the room temperature is controlled automatically.

phrases.stellt das Licht im Raum ein: sets the lighting in the room
phrases.stellt die Storen im Raum ein: sets the blinds in the room
phrases.stellt die Heizung im Raum ein: sets the heating in the room
phrases.Präsenzmelder: schaltet das Licht automa: Presence detector: switches the light on automatically when someone is in the room and off again after a while without movement.
phrases.Rauchmelder: warnt mit einem lauten Ton: Smoke detector: warns with a loud tone if there is smoke.
phrases.Fensterkontakt: meldet, ob das Fenster o: Window contact: reports whether the window is open.
phrases.Wetterstation: steuert Storen bei Wind,: Weather station: controls the blinds automatically in wind, rain and sun.
phrases.Temperaturfühler: misst die Raumtemperat: Temperature sensor: measures the room temperature.
